functions.name: ConvertPixelBitDepth
functions.summary: Bit-depth down-conversion of pixel data. a1 is a parameter block: *a1 element count, a1[1] buffer size (bytes/rows), byte at +8 a mode byte, byte at +9 the input bit depth. a2 is the destination pixel buffer, a3 a per-channel shift lookup table. If the mode byte is 3 the conversion is skipped. Otherwise per-channel shift amounts are computed as (bit_depth - a3[k]); shifts that are not positive are clamped to zero, and if any shift remains positive the buffer is converted according to the bit depth: 2 bpp (right-shift by 1, mask 0x55), 4 bpp (nibble mask 15/240), 8 bpp (per-channel right-shift), 16 bpp (16-bit load, right-shift, byte store). Channel count depends on mode bit 1 (interleaved vs planar) and mode bit 2 (extra fourth channel).

Compute per-channel shift amounts v19[k] = (bit depth byte at a1+9) - a3[k]: one value for planar, three for interleaved.
Test mode bit 2 ((a1[2] & 4) != 0): when set, add a fourth shift v19[v9] = (bit depth) - a3[4] for the extra channel.

Depth != 2: test depth == 4.

Depth not 4: test depth == 8.

Depth 16 path: for v9 * v5 elements, load a 16-bit pixel (v11[1] + (v11[0] << 8)), right-shift by v19[k % v9], and store the result as two bytes.
Return i (the mode/depth-derived value in LOBYTE of EAX); semantics of the return value are not established.
